title: Euler systems for self-dual Hecke characters over biquadratic fields with applications
summary: We construct a new Euler system attached to a self-dual Hecke character $χ$ over an imaginary biquadratic field $K_0$. The Euler system is anticyclotomic in the sense of Jetchev--Neková{\v r}--Skinner. As arithmetic applications, we deduce instances of the Bloch--Kato conjecture in analytic ranks $0$, $1$, and $2$ (the last one for certain CM abelian surfaces). In addition, we establish the full Iwasawa--Greenberg main conjecture for $χ$ over $K_0$.
